'''Orykan Tamarik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Thoris Darus]]' administration.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Orykan Tamarik was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]]. Selected to become the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Casieck Akinslesh]], Tamarik crafted her own blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] under Akinslesh's tutelage and she was greatly affected by his sudden death in [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]]. After a satisfactory mourning period, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided it was time to assign Tamarik a new master. As Master [[Tahl]] was to join Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his Padawan [[Xanatos]] on a [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|mission]] to [[Telos IV]], the High Council decided to test Tamarik's compatibility with the [[Noorian]] Jedi Master.<ref name="TDS1" />

While Tamarik was uncomfortable around Xanatos, she was able to defend herself upon their arrival when a group of insurgents attacked the Jedi's ship and forced them to draw their lightsabers. Later Tamarik accompanied Xanatos and his master to the rooftop where [[High Priestess/Legends|High Priestess]] [[Liora]] was murdered; Tamarik was able to reach into the Force and sense the actual murder take place while neither Xanatos or Jinn could see it. Collapsing from the shock of feeling the reverberations of the murder through the Force, Tamarik was escorted back to her quarters to recover. Later at a gala for [[Crion]], the ruler of Telos, Tamarik began talking with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Nason]], Xanatos' sister. While attempting to introduce the two, Xanatos made insensitive anti-alien remarks causing brief tension at the party. Meanwhile, Tahl and Jinn discussed Tamarik's future in private but were overheard by both Padawans; Xanatos' jealousy caused him to interpret Jinn's praise of the girl as meaning that she would eventually replace him as the Jedi's apprentice.<ref name="Jedi—The Dark Side 2">[[Jedi — The Dark Side 2|''Jedi — The Dark Side'' 2]]</ref>

When Tahl left for [[Landor]], Tamarik was left behind with Jinn as the mission was deemed too dangerous for the girl. Remaining in her quarters as [[Telosian Civil War|civil war]] erupted across the planet, Tamarik joined Master Jinn in battle as it was revealed that Lord Crion had fabricated the war in order to secure his place as dictator. While Tamarik lost her lightsaber and was nearly slain by Crion, Jinn rushed to her aid and slew the would-be tyrant, throwing his body into the beds of decorative fires within his palace. Xanatos, having just witnessed his master slay his father, attacked Tamarik as his anger rushed over him. Wearing the Twi'lek down easily, Xanatos was distracted by Jinn and was unable to achieve his goal of finishing Tamarik off with his lightsaber. As the fighting erupted over the capital, Jinn and Tamarik were able to escape, while Xanatos disappeared into the fray. While Tamarik returned by shuttle to the Jedi Temple, Jinn refused to return as he had to meditate on his failures with his former apprentice.<ref name="Jedi—The Dark Side 5">[[Jedi — The Dark Side 5|''Jedi — The Dark Side'' 5]]</ref>
